derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative of (a tetrad;
def: from G5064 (τέσσαρες)); a quaternion or squad (picket) of four Roman soldiers

occurrences.text: And when he had apprehended him, he put him in prison, and delivered him to four quaternions of soldiers to keep him; intending after Easter to bring him forth to the people.
